citations.narrative:
The indoor enclosure housing 12 domestic rabbits has wooden walls with damage from chewing and scratching from
previously housed animals that is not impervious to moisture. Interior surfaces shall be constructed and maintained so
that they are substantially impervious to moisture and may be readily sanitized to protect the health of the animals housed
within the enclosure. Correct by ensuring indoor surfaces for the rabbits are maintained so they are impervious to
moisture and can be readily sanitized.
***Correct by September 24th, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
